name: Long Run
author: Kandown
description: A resilient workflow for multi-session work using a living execution plan, explicit milestones, durable discoveries and decisions, clean handoffs, and independent verification.
summary: Keep long-running work resumable through a living plan, milestone evidence, handoffs, and verification.

taskTemplates.name: Living execution plan
taskTemplates.description: Owns the mission, milestones, progress, discoveries, decisions, recovery, and next handoff.

taskTemplates.name: Milestone increment
taskTemplates.description: Delivers one clean, mergeable increment and records a durable session handoff.

taskTemplates.name: Independent verification
taskTemplates.description: Verifies a milestone from a fresh context against its acceptance contract and evidence.
